description: End-to-end approval and provisioning workflow for Cloud Exchange (TaaS connectivity) circuits, including design, quote, multi-step approvals, ordering, provisioning, status tracking, modification, cancellation, and rollback.

request_id.description: Identifier for a connectivity design or quote request

quote_id.description: Identifier for a commercial quote associated with a request

order_id.description: Identifier for a confirmed connectivity order

connection_id.description: Identifier for a provisioned Cloud Exchange connection

approval_id.description: Identifier for a specific approval step in the workflow

endpoint.description: Network endpoint participating in the Cloud Exchange connection

bandwidth_profile.description: Bandwidth and QoS details for the requested connection

approver.description: User or system entity that approves a step

id.description: Identifier of the approver (user ID, group ID, etc.)

audit_event_id.description: Identifier of an audit log entry.

subscription_id.description: Identifier of a webhook or notification subscription.

snapshot_id.description: Identifier of a captured state snapshot.

functions.name: initiate_connectivity_request
functions.description: Create a new Cloud Exchange connectivity design and quote request for a tenant.

tenant_id.description: Tenant on whose behalf the request is made

endpoints.description: List of endpoints participating in the connection (min 2).

constraints.description: Technical and policy constraints to respect.

tags.description: Free-form tags for search and policy.

functions.returns: New request_id, initial status, and a summary of the request.

functions.name: evaluate_connectivity_design
functions.description: Run automated design, feasibility, and cost estimation for a connectivity request.

evaluation_options.description: Tuning parameters for the design engine.

force_rerun.description: Recompute even if an evaluation already exists.

functions.returns: Design alternatives with technical paths, feasibility flags, and preliminary pricing ranges bound to the request.

functions.name: generate_connectivity_quote
functions.description: Generate a formal commercial quote for a selected design alternative associated with a request.

design_alternative_id.description: Identifier of the chosen design alternative.

discounts.description: Discounts or promo codes to be applied.

custom_approval_required.description: Set true if non-standard discounting is requested.

functions.returns: A quote_id linked to the request, with detailed recurring and one-time charges and quote status.

functions.name: start_approval_workflow
functions.description: Initiate a multi-step approval workflow for a quote and its associated connectivity design.

approval_policy.description: Explicit approval policy to use; if omitted, use default for tenant.

sla_hours.description: Expected time to approve this step.

metadata.description: Additional attributes for this approval workflow instance.

functions.returns: Approval workflow instance id, initial approval_id for the first step, and overall approval status.

functions.name: record_approval_decision
functions.description: Record an approve or reject decision for a specific approval step and advance the workflow.

approval_id.description: Identifier for the approval step instance.

actor.description: User or system making the decision.

attachments.description: Supporting documents such as risk assessments or architectural diagrams.

override_policy.description: Indicate that this decision overrides normal quorum or ordering rules.

functions.returns: Updated approval step status, overall quote approval status, and the next pending approval_id if any.

functions.name: get_approval_status
functions.description: Retrieve detailed approval status for a quote, including step-by-step decisions and history.
functions.returns: Current approval state of the quote, list of steps with decisions, pending approvers, and escalation information.

functions.name: create_connectivity_order
functions.description: Create a connectivity order from an approved quote, including technical and implementation details.

implementation_preferences.description: Preferences for how and when to implement the connection.

technical_overrides.description: Optional technical overrides vs the quote/design (may require re-approval).

client_reference.description: Customer’s internal reference number or PO.

functions.returns: Created order_id, order status, and any additional approvals required due to overrides.

functions.name: provision_connectivity
functions.description: Trigger automated provisioning for an order to create one or more Cloud Exchange connections.

dry_run.description: If true, only validate and calculate steps without making changes.

rollback_on_failure.description: If true, automatically roll back partial provisioning on errors.

functions.returns: Provisioning task id, immediate validation results, and initial status of each planned connection_id.

functions.name: get_order_and_connection_status
functions.description: Retrieve consolidated status for an order and its associated connections and provisioning tasks.

include_telemetry.description: If true, include recent telemetry such as link up/down or throughput metrics.

functions.returns: Order status, per-connection state and health, event history, and any outstanding actions or approvals.

functions.name: modify_connection
functions.description: Request a modification to an existing connection, such as bandwidth change or technical parameter update.
functions.returns: Modification request id, whether additional approvals are required, and the planned implementation window.

functions.name: cancel_or_suspend_order
functions.description: Cancel, suspend, or resume an order and optionally its active or in-progress connections.

connection_ids.description: If provided, limit the action to these connections.

effective_time.description: When the cancel/suspend/resume should become effective.

functions.returns: Order and connection states after applying the action, including any pending deprovision tasks and financial implications.

functions.name: retry_or_rollback_provisioning
functions.description: Retry failed provisioning steps for a connection or roll back to a known good state.

diagnostics.description: Optional diagnostics context to assist troubleshooting.

functions.returns: New provisioning task id, resulting connection state, and a summary of steps retried or rolled back.

functions.name: list_requests_quotes_orders
functions.description: Search and list connectivity requests, quotes, and orders for reporting and operational visibility.
functions.returns: Paginated list of matching requests, quotes, and/or orders with high-level status, approval state, and key attributes.

functions.name: get_connectivity_entity_details
functions.description: Retrieve detailed information about a specific request, quote, order, or connection, including lifecycle and approval info.

id.description: Identifier of the entity (request_id, quote_id, order_id, or connection_id).

functions.returns: Full entity details and optionally its design, pricing, approvals, provisioning tasks, telemetry, and audit history.

functions.name: search_requests
functions.description: Faceted search across request records with rich filters, full-text query, and faceted aggregations for cloud_exchange_connectivity_approval_flow.

filters.description: Boolean filter tree with nested AND/OR support

value.description: Comparison value, type depends on op

highlight.description: Return highlighted snippets when matching text

cursor.description: Opaque continuation token for stable pagination

actor.description: Caller identity used for audit and authorization

functions.returns: A paginated result set of request records with facet buckets, total count, and continuation cursor.

functions.name: list_requests_by_status
functions.description: List request records filtered by lifecycle status with stable cursor pagination.

cursor.description: Opaque continuation token for stable pagination

actor.description: Caller identity used for audit and authorization

functions.returns: A paginated list of request records matching the requested statuses, optionally with summary metrics.

functions.name: get_request_detail
functions.description: Fetch a single request record with optional expansion of related entities and versioned snapshots.

as_of.description: Read the record as of this point in time

version_id.description: Specific version to retrieve when versioning is enabled

actor.description: Caller identity used for audit and authorization

functions.returns: A request record with the requested expansions and version metadata.

functions.name: bulk_create_requests
functions.description: Submit a batch of request records for creation, with idempotency keys and partial-success reporting.

tags.description: Tags applied to the new record

trace_id.description: Correlation id propagated across the batch

actor.description: Caller identity used for audit and authorization

functions.returns: A per-item outcome list with created identifiers, validation errors, and batch-level statistics.

functions.name: bulk_update_requests
functions.description: Apply partial updates to many request records in a single transactional batch.

selector.description: Boolean filter tree with nested AND/OR support

value.description: Comparison value, type depends on op

patch.description: JSON merge-patch applied to every matched record

dry_run.description: Compute affected count without applying changes

actor.description: Caller identity used for audit and authorization

functions.returns: Affected record count, sampled previews, and any per-record errors.

functions.name: bulk_archive_requests
functions.description: Soft-archive request records matching a selector with optional grace period before purge.

selector.description: Boolean filter tree with nested AND/OR support

value.description: Comparison value, type depends on op

preserve_audit.description: Keep audit trail even after purge

actor.description: Caller identity used for audit and authorization

functions.returns: Archive operation summary including matched count, scheduled purge date, and any blockers.

functions.name: export_requests
functions.description: Asynchronously export a filtered slice of request records to the configured object store.

selector.description: Boolean filter tree with nested AND/OR support

value.description: Comparison value, type depends on op

destination.description: Where the export should be delivered

actor.description: Caller identity used for audit and authorization

functions.returns: An export job descriptor with status, destination URI, and progress callbacks.

functions.name: subscribe_request_events
functions.description: Register a webhook subscription for request lifecycle events with HMAC signing and replay protection.

filter.description: Boolean filter tree with nested AND/OR support

value.description: Comparison value, type depends on op

signing_secret_ref.description: Reference to the HMAC signing secret

tls_verify.description: Whether to validate the server certificate

actor.description: Caller identity used for audit and authorization

functions.returns: A subscription handle including subscription_id, verification status, and current delivery health.

functions.name: unsubscribe_request_events
functions.description: Disable or delete a previously created request event subscription.

drain_seconds.description: Grace period to flush in-flight events

actor.description: Caller identity used for audit and authorization

functions.returns: Final subscription state and any undelivered event counts at the time of termination.

functions.name: get_request_audit_history
functions.description: Retrieve the chronological audit log for a request including who changed what and when.

cursor.description: Opaque continuation token for stable pagination

actor.description: Caller identity used for audit and authorization

functions.returns: An ordered list of audit entries with diffs, actor metadata, and correlation ids.

functions.name: query_request_changelog
functions.description: Query the cross-record changelog for cloud_exchange_connectivity_approval_flow with field-level filters.

selector.description: Boolean filter tree with nested AND/OR support

value.description: Comparison value, type depends on op

fields_changed.description: Restrict to changes touching these fields

cursor.description: Opaque continuation token for stable pagination

actor.description: Caller identity used for audit and authorization

functions.returns: Aggregated changelog rows or detail entries depending on group_by, plus totals.

functions.name: schedule_request_job
functions.description: Create a recurring or one-off scheduled job that runs a cloud_exchange_connectivity_approval_flow operation.

operation.description: Operation name to invoke when the schedule fires

input_template.description: Parameters passed to the operation, with templating

failure_policy.description: What to do when a run fails

max_failures.description: Pause schedule after this many failures

alert_channel.description: Channel id to alert on failure

actor.description: Caller identity used for audit and authorization

functions.returns: A schedule descriptor including schedule_id, next run time, and validation issues.

functions.name: pause_request_schedule
functions.description: Temporarily pause a scheduled cloud_exchange_connectivity_approval_flow job without deleting its history.

actor.description: Caller identity used for audit and authorization

functions.returns: Updated schedule status and prior pause history.

functions.name: simulate_request_execution
functions.description: Run a dry-run simulation of a cloud_exchange_connectivity_approval_flow execution path without producing side effects.

include_side_effect_plan.description: Return the side effects that would have been emitted

actor.description: Caller identity used for audit and authorization

functions.returns: Simulation transcript with predicted outcome, side-effect plan, and assertions checked.

functions.name: preview_request_change
functions.description: Compute a preview of how a proposed change would affect a request prior to commit.

evaluate_policies.description: Run policy engine against the proposed state

actor.description: Caller identity used for audit and authorization

functions.returns: A preview document with field diffs, policy verdicts, and dependency impact.

functions.name: submit_request_for_approval
functions.description: Submit a request for review with configurable approver routing and SLA targets.

approver_group.description: Group or role authorised at this step

actor.description: Caller identity used for audit and authorization

functions.returns: Approval workflow handle with approval_id, current step, and projected completion time.

functions.name: record_request_approval_decision
functions.description: Record an approve/reject/recuse decision for a pending request approval step.

conditions.description: Conditions attached to a conditional approval

actor.description: Caller identity used for audit and authorization

functions.returns: Updated approval state, next pending step, and any triggered automations.

functions.name: escalate_request
functions.description: Escalate a stuck or breached request to a higher tier with paging and audit.

target_team.description: Team or rota receiving the escalation

context_refs.description: Related artifact ids attached for context

actor.description: Caller identity used for audit and authorization

functions.returns: Escalation record id, paged responders, and acknowledgement timer.

functions.name: add_request_comment
functions.description: Append a comment, optionally with @mentions and visibility scope, to a request.

mentions.description: User ids mentioned in the body

parent_comment_id.description: Comment id this one replies to

actor.description: Caller identity used for audit and authorization

functions.returns: Newly created comment record including comment_id and resolved mentions.

functions.name: attach_request_evidence
functions.description: Upload an evidence file or link as an attachment to a request with content hash and retention.

actor.description: Caller identity used for audit and authorization

functions.returns: Attachment descriptor including attachment_id, content hash, and stored URI.

functions.name: snapshot_request_state
functions.description: Capture a point-in-time snapshot of a request and its dependencies for restore or audit.

actor.description: Caller identity used for audit and authorization

functions.returns: Snapshot descriptor with snapshot_id, captured size, and storage URI.

functions.name: restore_request_from_snapshot
functions.description: Restore a request (and optionally dependencies) from a previously captured snapshot.

new_owner_id.description: Owner of the restored record when mode=new_record

actor.description: Caller identity used for audit and authorization

functions.returns: Restore job descriptor with conflicts surfaced and final record id.

functions.name: get_request_metrics_summary
functions.description: Compute summary KPIs for cloud_exchange_connectivity_approval_flow over a time window with optional segmentation.

metrics.description: Metric names to compute (e.g. throughput, p95_latency, failure_rate)

filters.description: Boolean filter tree with nested AND/OR support

value.description: Comparison value, type depends on op

compare_to_previous_period.description: Include delta vs the previous equal-length window

actor.description: Caller identity used for audit and authorization

functions.returns: A metrics document with per-bucket values, totals, and optional period-over-period deltas.

functions.name: create_request_dashboard
functions.description: Define a dashboard layout combining charts and tables for cloud_exchange_connectivity_approval_flow.

query.description: Query spec, polymorphic by panel type

actor.description: Caller identity used for audit and authorization

functions.returns: Dashboard descriptor including dashboard_id and resolved share list.

functions.name: define_request_policy
functions.description: Create or version a policy controlling allowed cloud_exchange_connectivity_approval_flow behaviour.

rules.description: Ordered rule list, first match wins

when.description: Boolean filter tree with nested AND/OR support

value.description: Comparison value, type depends on op

enforcement_mode.description: How strictly the policy is applied

actor.description: Caller identity used for audit and authorization

functions.returns: Policy version descriptor with policy_id, version_id, and validation report.

functions.name: evaluate_request_policies
functions.description: Evaluate the active cloud_exchange_connectivity_approval_flow policies against a candidate input and return verdicts.

actor.description: Caller identity used for audit and authorization

functions.returns: Aggregate verdict, per-rule outcomes, and any obligations attached to the decision.
